turns.text: Did you use a range of connectives discourse markers on the one hand on the other hand.
turns.zh: 你有没有用一系列连接词和话语标记，比如「一方面」「另一方面」？

turns.text: That's it vocab did you use a wide range of vocab flexibly?
turns.zh: 词汇就这些——你有没有灵活地使用各种词汇？

turns.text: What was the best word that you use?
turns.zh: 你用过的最好的词是哪个？

turns.text: Pop that in the comments box perhaps?
turns.zh: 也许可以把它填到评论框里？

turns.text: Did you use some less common idiomatic language?
turns.zh: 你有没有用一些不太常见的习语表达？

turns.text: Okay, so let me get this straight idiomatic language.
turns.zh: 好，那让我确认一下——习语表达。
